finding: The apparent 14 retained raw matrices are not the complete dependency closure. Net leadership and hedge-ratio factors require four additional raw matrices, so 18 outputs and 19 original recurrence channels are needed. A 16-slot pack cannot preserve all of them.

candidate_layout.slot19_note: ext_opp_t5 output is not required, but this slot carries the negative ext_t5 history needed by ext_same_t5; optionally accumulate its unused output to keep adjacent +/- lane structure simple.
candidate_layout.grouping: First 8 lanes: 7 unsigned fields plus padding; next 16 lanes: signed +/- pairs from flow, urgency and extreme-order families. Every retained output keeps its original lane-local arithmetic.

equivalence_constraints: Keep every preprocessing record, StockPrep/cells/cells_pm, StockStats field, row universe, industry lookup and error policy unchanged.

Keep phase1 bucket order, 4096-bucket block boundaries, carry state and f32 decay constants. Each retained history uses the same add-half-input and then (state+input)*decay operations; do not replace repeated decay with exponentiation or skip empty buckets.

Keep phase2 A-cell order, SUB=2 boundaries and per-lane FMA order. Unsigned lanes use the original single FMA; signed lanes use the negative-side inner FMA followed by the positive-side outer FMA. Do not add dummy zero FMAs to unsigned outputs.
Keep the original per-pair +/- permutation within mixed-family vectors. Same-only extreme output still consumes both positive and negative histories.
Use an explicit matrix subset interface rather than the existing family mask: all six families remain represented, so FAM_* cannot express this reduction.
Emit the same 115 named lite columns in the original order. Validate the dependency closure against the fixed name set; missing hidden inputs must not silently become NaN.
Keep the compact path limited to the union request; legacy full-matrix callers still require all 28 outputs.

split_dependency_audit.conclusion: compute_split_from_prep consumes stocks, stats and industry, then builds its own four split matrices; it does not consume the 28 lite matrices.

possible_costs: Mixing families means constructing heterogeneous u vectors per cell rather than only broadcasting one family scalar. This can offset savings and requires a dedicated exact microbenchmark.
Memory layout/less allocation may help, but neither speedup nor peak RSS has been measured for this proposal.

The existing 6-vector phase1 could become 3 vectors; phase2 lane arithmetic could use 5 rather than 9 eight-lane FMA instructions per cell. These are source-level operation counts, not throughput measurements.

measured_stage_cap.interpretation: 36.03 seconds is the latest observed time of the complete matrix stage. Even deleting this entire stage for free would save at most that recorded segment in that run. A real exact compact implementation must still compute the required matrices, so its savings would be smaller. This is not a theoretical hardware lower bound or a promised saving.

prior_work_check.finding: No compact union-specific 18-output/24-slot experiment was found in this task evidence. The discarded GPT transpose and pair scan16 experiments optimize different kernels; their failure does not establish this proposal is fast or slow. Historical 37-to-28 matrix pruning changed a different contract and must not be repeated here.

required_before_adoption: Standalone phase1/phase2 comparison against frozen 48-slot baseline, including carry across blocks and all retained slots.
Meaningful microbenchmarks using real/representative sparse cells and complete processing, without changing thread count.
Three full dates with all 18758 names and values unchanged, then fixed-50-thread entry timing.
